faulty-product.name: Faulty Product
faulty-product.description: Issues involving defective, damaged, unsafe or poor-quality products.

process.title: Identify the issue
process.description: Clearly identify the defect or problem with the product.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep the bill, warranty, order details, photographs and other relevant evidence.

process.title: Contact the seller or manufacturer
process.description: Ask the seller or manufacturer to resolve the issue through repair, replacement or refund.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the issue is not resolved, you may approach the appropriate consumer grievance mechanism.

documents.title: Purchase Bill or Invoice
documents.description: Proof of purchase showing the product, seller and transaction details.

documents.title: Warranty or Guarantee Card
documents.description: Warranty or guarantee documents provided with the product.

documents.title: Photographs or Videos
documents.description: Visual evidence clearly showing the defect or damage.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: Emails, messages or letters exchanged with the seller or manufacturer.

remedies.title: Refund
remedies.description: Full or partial refund of the amount paid for the product.

remedies.title: Repair
remedies.description: Free repair of the defective product.

remedies.title: Replacement
remedies.description: Replacement of the product with a new one of the same type.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for any loss or damage caused due to the defect.

laws.text: Provides protection to consumers against defective goods and establishes mechanisms for dispute redressal.
Contains provisions relating to the quality, fitness and sale of goods.

faulty-product.sample_letter: I purchased [PRODUCT] from [SELLER] on [DATE]. The product has the following defect: [DESCRIBE ISSUE]. I request that the issue be resolved by [REPAIR / REPLACEMENT / REFUND].

service-deficiency.name: Service Deficiency
service-deficiency.description: Issues arising from inadequate, delayed, incomplete or deficient services.

process.title: Identify the deficiency
process.description: Record what service was promised and how the actual service fell short.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep agreements, invoices, receipts, work orders and all related communications.

process.title: Contact the service provider
process.description: Raise the issue with the service provider and request a suitable resolution.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the service provider does not resolve the issue, use the appropriate consumer grievance mechanism.

documents.title: Service Agreement / Contract
documents.description: Written agreement or terms that specify the service to be provided.

documents.title: Invoice or Payment Receipt
documents.description: Proof of payment made for the service.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: Emails, chats, letters or call records with the service provider.

documents.title: Evidence of Deficiency
documents.description: Photos, videos, screenshots or reports showing the poor or incomplete service.

remedies.title: Refund
remedies.description: Refund of the amount paid for the deficient service.

remedies.title: Re-performance of Service
remedies.description: The service provider may be directed to perform the service again properly.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for loss, inconvenience or additional expenses caused.

laws.text: Provides protection against deficiency in services and establishes mechanisms for consumer dispute redressal.

service-deficiency.sample_letter: I availed [SERVICE] from [SERVICE PROVIDER] on [DATE]. The service was deficient because [DESCRIBE ISSUE]. I request [REMEDY].

billing-fraud.name: Billing Fraud
billing-fraud.description: Problems involving incorrect, unauthorized, duplicate or misleading billing and charges.

process.title: Check the bill carefully
process.description: Review the bill and identify any incorrect, duplicate or unauthorized charges.

process.title: Keep all evidence
process.description: Save bills, receipts, payment records, statements and related communications.

process.title: Raise the issue
process.description: Contact the business or service provider and request correction of the billing error.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the issue remains unresolved, use an appropriate grievance or consumer forum mechanism.

documents.title: Original Bill / Invoice
documents.description: The bill that contains the disputed or incorrect charges.

documents.title: Payment Proof
documents.description: Bank statements, UPI receipts or payment confirmations.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: Emails or messages sent to the company regarding the billing issue.

documents.title: Previous Bills (if any)
documents.description: Earlier correct bills for comparison.

remedies.title: Refund of Excess Amount
remedies.description: Refund of any excess or unauthorized amount charged.

remedies.title: Correction of Bill
remedies.description: Correction of the bill and issuance of a revised statement.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for any financial loss or hardship caused by the incorrect billing.

laws.text: Protects consumers against unfair trade practices including incorrect or misleading billing.

billing-fraud.sample_letter: I received a bill/invoice from [BUSINESS] dated [DATE] containing the following incorrect or unauthorized charge: [DESCRIBE CHARGE]. I request correction of the bill and [REFUND / OTHER REMEDY].

e-commerce.name: E-commerce
e-commerce.description: Consumer issues related to online purchases, sellers, delivery, refunds, returns or digital transactions.

process.title: Record the order details
process.description: Note the order ID, product details, seller name, platform and date of purchase.

process.title: Collect evidence
process.description: Save screenshots, invoices, delivery records, product photos and chat/email history.

process.title: Contact the platform or seller
process.description: Use the platform’s customer support, return/refund option or grievance mechanism.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the issue is not resolved, approach the consumer commission or relevant online dispute resolution mechanism.

documents.title: Order Confirmation / Invoice
documents.description: Order ID, invoice and payment confirmation from the platform.

documents.title: Delivery Proof
documents.description: Tracking details, delivery receipt or unboxing photos/videos.

documents.title: Product Photographs
documents.description: Clear photos or videos showing the received product and any defect.

documents.title: Chat / Email Records
documents.description: Conversation history with the seller or platform support.

remedies.title: Refund
remedies.description: Full or partial refund of the amount paid.

remedies.title: Replacement
remedies.description: Replacement of the product with a new one.

remedies.title: Return
remedies.description: Return of the product and refund as per the platform’s policy.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for delay, damage or extra costs incurred.

laws.text: Includes specific provisions for e-commerce and protects consumers in online transactions.
Lays down duties of e-commerce entities and marketplace sellers.

e-commerce.sample_letter: I placed order [ORDER ID] for [PRODUCT] from [PLATFORM/SELLER] on [DATE]. The issue is [DESCRIBE ISSUE]. I request [REFUND / REPLACEMENT / OTHER REMEDY].

banking-financial.name: Banking / Financial
banking-financial.description: Consumer issues involving banking or financial services, unauthorized transactions, charges, loans or related deficiencies.

process.title: Record the transaction
process.description: Note the date, amount, reference number, account details and exact nature of the problem.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep account statements, transaction receipts, SMS alerts, emails and any related correspondence.

process.title: Contact the bank / provider
process.description: Raise a formal complaint through the bank’s grievance redressal system or customer care.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If not resolved, approach the Banking Ombudsman, RBI or the appropriate consumer forum.

documents.title: Bank Statement / Passbook
documents.description: Relevant account statement showing the disputed transaction or charge.

documents.title: Transaction Receipt / SMS Alert
documents.description: Confirmation SMS, email or receipt of the transaction in question.

documents.title: Complaint Acknowledgement
documents.description: Copy of the complaint lodged with the bank and any reference number given.

documents.title: Related Documents
documents.description: Loan agreement, card statements or any other supporting papers.

remedies.title: Refund / Reversal
remedies.description: Refund or reversal of unauthorized or excess amount charged.

remedies.title: Correction of Records
remedies.description: Correction of account records and statements.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for financial loss and mental harassment.

laws.text: Applies to banking and financial services as ‘services’ under the Act.
Provides an alternative grievance redressal mechanism for banking customers.

banking-financial.sample_letter: I am writing regarding [TRANSACTION/SERVICE] dated [DATE] involving [BANK/FINANCIAL SERVICE PROVIDER]. The issue is [DESCRIBE ISSUE]. I request [REMEDY].

other.name: Other
other.description: For consumer issues that do not clearly fit into the categories above.

process.title: Identify the issue
process.description: Clearly describe the problem and the outcome you expected.

process.title: Collect documents
process.description: Keep all bills, receipts, agreements, photos and communication related to the issue.

process.title: Contact the concerned party
process.description: Raise the issue with the seller, service provider or organisation concerned.

process.title: Escalate if unresolved
process.description: If the issue is not resolved, approach the appropriate consumer grievance mechanism.

documents.title: Bill / Invoice / Receipt
documents.description: Any proof of purchase or payment related to the issue.

documents.title: Agreement or Terms
documents.description: Written terms, contract or policy documents if available.

documents.title: Photographs or Screenshots
documents.description: Visual evidence of the problem.

documents.title: Communication Records
documents.description: All emails, messages or letters exchanged regarding the issue.

remedies.title: Refund
remedies.description: Refund of the amount paid.

remedies.title: Repair / Replacement / Correction
remedies.description: Repair, replacement or proper correction of the problem.

remedies.title: Compensation
remedies.description: Compensation for loss or inconvenience caused.

laws.text: Provides overall protection to consumers and mechanisms for dispute redressal.

other.sample_letter: I am writing regarding [PRODUCT/SERVICE] obtained from [BUSINESS] on [DATE]. The issue is [DESCRIBE ISSUE]. I request [REMEDY].
